decisions.decision: Guarantee the resume with a TEST, not a note
decisions.rationale: BACK-A11Y-01 was invisible ~3 months after a v5.0 archive; BACK-89 drifted P2->P1 invisible for 3.5 months; v5.24 slipped three boundaries. In every case the work WAS written down — writing it down is what failed.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D1 — every ratio divides by the population its own numerator is drawn from
decisions.rationale: Not a new principle: agility_high_impact_ratio already did it, and _endpoints_assessed's docstring already instructed it. 34 sites were inconsistent with the one site and the one docstring that already said it.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D1(d) — agility_high_impact_ratio ALSO had the defect
decisions.rationale: Orchestrator initially and wrongly fenced it off as 'the one site that was always correct'. It divided 19 high-impact findings by 398 TOTAL findings, 330 of them INFO. Found by arithmetic during implementation, not by inspection.

decisions.decision: 999.113 D5 — do not tune to a target
decisions.rationale: The lab score must move because the denominator became meaningful, not because someone picked a number that demos well. Held: the executor reported 87 against a <40 target and changed no weights.

decisions.decision: Choose the next scoring model BY MEASUREMENT, not argument
decisions.rationale: Attempt #1 (Phase 188 SCORE-06) failed because nothing could tell whether a change had helped — ~3,200 lines of scoring tests were green the whole time the score was blind.

decisions.decision: Reverse Phase 184.4 D-03 — severity now caps the NUMBER, not only the band
decisions.rationale: Operator-approved 2026-09-14. D-03's separation produced the product's central incoherence: a catastrophic estate whose number said 87 (numerically EXCELLENT) while its label said FAIR. Superseded, not deleted; D-03's rationale is preserved in full.

decisions.decision: COMPRESS into [0, ceiling], never CLAMP to it
decisions.rationale: Found by measurement, not design. A hard min(score, ceiling) made the score INERT on capped estates — remediation lift +0, all three calibration profiles collapsed to one number. The roadmap would have shown '+0 points' against every recommendation the product makes. Without compression the change is a regression.

decisions.decision: Ceiling thresholds derived from BAND_THRESHOLDS, not hardcoded
decisions.rationale: 'Cap at POOR' IS FAIR-1; 'cap at FAIR' IS MODERATE-1. Reading them via _top_of_band() collapses the free-parameter count from four to one (DEEP_CRITICAL_CEILING=25, from the operator's R5 rung) and makes a future band rebalance carry them along.

decisions.decision: PQC as a CEILING, never a bonus
decisions.rationale: Forced, not preferred: agility_pqc_hybrid_bonus is already the joint-largest bonus at 8.0 and measurement showed PQC adoption moving the score by exactly 0, because _apply_weighted_impacts clamps each domain at 25 and a clean estate is already there. Any bonus is absorbed the same way.

decisions.decision: Remove agility_high_impact_ratio rather than re-denominate it
decisions.rationale: 999.113 D1(d) fixed its denominator, which was right and insufficient — ANY ratio there carries the defect, because a finding count is not a population badness is proportional to. _consequence_ceiling() now carries that signal absolutely. Measured: removing it closes P1 with the ladder intact; removing it WITHOUT the ceiling closes nothing.

The model has stopped moving; what remains is test repair and release hygiene, not design. TWO THINGS A RESUMING AGENT MUST NOT UNDO.
